BrochureContent.Content:
The Property Shop welcome number 23 Manor Place, to the Dublin 7 market.  An original artisan home in one family for almost 100 years, this is a rare find and a great opportunity to become part of the ever popular community of Stoneybatter.  This fine property will not disappoint, an original 3 bedroom home with 2 large reception rooms, extended kitchen and shower room, original features, a sunny South facing patio garden to the rear. There is plenty of scope to create a spacious city home in this sought after location.  Well presented and maintained by the family over the years the property benefits from GFCH and double glazed windows through out.  The location is ideal, Manor Place is home to Slice Cafe and just off Stoneybatter`s main street which has  many destination shops, cafes, bars and restaurants.  Great local amenities are close by including the TU Campus at Grangegorman with easy access to the park area, the Phoenix Park, Smithfield Village, both Lidl & Tesco Supermarkets, the City Centre and a selection of  local national schools including Dublin 7 Educate Together at Grangegorman. For those looking for City living with all the convenience and friendliness of an urban village, viewing this property is highly recommended. Viewing is by appointment only through our Manor Street office.

Parlour Room 3.22m (10'7") x 4.07m (13'4")
The original parlour room to the front of the home with built in shelving, picture rail & coving.

Living Room 3.86m (12'8") x 3.3m (10'10")
Living room to the rear with built in storage and fireplace.

Kitchen/ Dining 3.9m (12'10") x 2.37m (7'9")
To the rear a galley style kitchen with eye & floor level units, tiled surround, plumbed for laundry, access to the rear yard.

Shower Room 2.4m (7'10") x 1.72m (5'8")
Fully tiled shower room with Triton t90 electric shower, WHB & WC.

Bedroom 3 2.76m (9'1") x 2.15m (7'1")
On the first floor return, single bedroom with vaulted ceilings.

Bedroom 2 3.7m (12'2") x 3.36m (11'0")
Large double bedroom to the rear with built in wardrobes.

Bedroom 1 3.42m (11'3") x 5.28m (17'4")
A second spacious double bedroom to the front of the property with built in wardrobes and WC Ensuite.

Exterior 5.29m (17'4") x 3m (9'10")
Large South facing patio garden to the rear laid in patio slab and raised beds.  On street residents disc parking to the front.
